_about: Shared labels for the whole team. The classifier, extraction, and map all use these exact words. Do not rename a label once teammates use it; add new ones only after agreeing as a team.

business_types.p2p_transfer: Moving money between users of the same app
business_types.remittance: Sending money abroad to another person
business_types.stored_value: Holding customer balances or selling prepaid value
business_types.bill_payment: Paying a customer's bills to companies
business_types.payroll_processing: Receiving employer money and paying employees
business_types.marketplace_payments: Collecting from buyers and paying sellers
business_types.virtual_currency: Holding or sending crypto or stablecoins
business_types.currency_exchange: Exchanging one country's currency for another
business_types.software_only: Technology that never touches customer money

exemptions.government: Federal, state, or local government and their agents
exemptions.postal_service: U.S. Postal Service and its agents
exemptions.agent_of_payee: Collecting payment on behalf of the seller or biller
exemptions.payment_intermediary: Processing payments for a company that owes the transfer
exemptions.authorized_delegate: Agent acting on behalf of a licensee
exemptions.employee: Employees acting for a licensee or exempt company
exemptions.service_provider_to_bank: Service providers or agents of an exempt bank
exemptions.board_of_trade: Designated boards of trade and their clearing providers
exemptions.attorney_or_title: Attorneys or title companies in real estate deals
exemptions.regulator_exempts: Anyone the regulator exempts by rule or order
exemptions.incidental_business: Money transmission only incidental to an unrelated main business, exempted by the regulator on application
exemptions.blockchain_software: Software that facilitates transactions on a blockchain
exemptions.other: Anything else; explain in the note
